<script>
'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),MM=96/25.4,KEY='label-workshop-v1',LIBKEY='label-workshop-templates-v1';
const icons=name=>'<svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-'+name+'"/></svg>';
const escapeHTML=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const clone=o=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));const round=v=>Math.round(v*100)/100;
const fonts={sans:'"Microsoft JhengHei","PingFang TC",Arial,sans-serif',serif:'"PMingLiU","Songti TC",serif',kai:'"DFKai-SB","BiauKai",serif',mono:'Consolas,"Microsoft JhengHei",monospace'};
function localDate(){let d=new Date();return [d.getFullYear(),String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')].join('-')}
function validDate(s){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s))return false;let d=new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z');return Number.isFinite(+d)&&d.toISOString().slice(0,10)===s}
function expiryDate(f){if(f.expiryMode==='manual')return f.manualExpiry;if(!validDate(f.made))return '';const d=new Date(f.made+'T00:00:00Z');d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+Number(f.days)-(f.countMode==='inclusive'?1:0));return d.toISOString().slice(0,10)}
function formatDate(s,f){if(!validDate(s))return '—';let [y,m,d]=s.split('-');if(f.dateFormat==='roc')y=String(+y-1911);return [y,m,d].join({dash:'-',dot:'.'}[f.dateFormat]||'/')}
let pendingPrintCount=null;let serial=0;const uid=()=>Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+(++serial);
function txt(id,text,x,y,w,size=8,bold=false,align='left'){return {id,type:'text',text,x,y,w,size,bold,align,font:'sans',rotation:0}}
function builtins(n=0){if(n===1)return [txt('brand','{{標題}}',2,1.5,31,7,true),txt('product','{{商品名稱}}',2,5,31,10,true),{id:'line',type:'line',x:2,y:10,w:31,thickness:.2,rotation:0},txt('made','製造：{{製造日期}}',2,11.5,31,7),txt('expiry','有效：{{有效日期}}',2,15,31,7,true),txt('storage','{{保存方式}}',2,18.4,31,6.5),txt('batch','批號：{{批號}}',2,21.5,31,6)];if(n===2)return [txt('product','{{商品名稱}}',2,2,31,9,true,'center'),txt('label','有效日期',2,7.5,31,7,false,'center'),txt('expiry','{{有效日期}}',1.5,11,32,12,true,'center'),txt('storage','{{保存方式}}',2,19,31,7,false,'center')];return [txt('brand','{{標題}}',2,1.8,31,6.5,false,'center'),txt('product','{{商品名稱}}',2,5.1,31,11,true,'center'),{id:'line',type:'line',x:2,y:11,w:31,thickness:.2,rotation:0},txt('made','製造日期  {{製造日期}}',2,12.5,31,7),txt('expiry','有效日期  {{有效日期}}',2,16.1,31,7,true),txt('storage','{{保存方式}}',2,20.3,31,6.5,false,'center')]}
function defaultState(){return {version:1,paper:{w:35,h:25,offsetX:0,offsetY:0},fields:{product:'手作鮮奶酪',brand:'日日手作 · 新鮮製作',storage:'冷藏保存・開封後請儘速食用',made:localDate(),days:3,countMode:'inclusive',expiryMode:'auto',manualExpiry:localDate(),dateFormat:'slash',batch:'',note:''},elements:builtins(0),copies:1}}
function normalize(raw){if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||raw.version!==1||!raw.paper||!raw.fields||!Array.isArray(raw.elements)||raw.elements.length>80)throw Error('不是有效的標籤版型檔案');let n=defaultState();const num=(v,a,b)=>{if(typeof v!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(v)||v<a||v>b)throw Error('版型中的尺寸或數值不正確');return v};n.paper={w:num(raw.paper.w,10,200),h:num(raw.paper.h,10,300),offsetX:num(raw.paper.offsetX??0,-10,10),offsetY:num(raw.paper.offsetY??0,-10,10)};for(const k of ['product','brand','storage','batch','note']){if(typeof raw.fields[k]!=='string'||raw.fields[k].length>1000)throw Error('版型的文字資料不正確');n.fields[k]=raw.fields[k]}for(const k of ['made','manualExpiry']){if(!validDate(raw.fields[k]))throw Error('版型的日期不正確');n.fields[k]=raw.fields[k]}n.fields.days=num(raw.fields.days,1,3650);for(const [k,opts]of Object.entries({countMode:['inclusive','exclusive'],expiryMode:['auto','manual'],dateFormat:['slash','dash','dot','roc']})){if(!opts.includes(raw.fields[k]))throw Error('版型格式不支援');n.fields[k]=raw.fields[k]}n.elements=raw.elements.map(e=>{if(!['text','line'].includes(e.type))throw Error('不支援的物件');let p={id:uid(),type:e.type,x:num(e.x,-200,300),y:num(e.y,-300,500),w:num(e.w,1,300),rotation:[0,90,180,270].includes(e.rotation)?e.rotation:0};if(e.type==='line')p.thickness=num(e.thickness,.1,3);else Object.assign(p,{text:String(e.text??'').slice(0,2000),size:num(e.size,4,72),bold:!!e.bold,align:['left','center','right'].includes(e.align)?e.align:'left',font:fonts[e.font]?e.font:'sans'});return p});n.copies=clamp(Math.round(Number(raw.copies)||1),1,200);return n}
let state=defaultState(),storageOK=true;try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(raw)state=normalize(JSON.parse(raw))}catch(e){storageOK=false}
let selected=state.elements.find(e=>e.id==='product')?.id||state.elements.find(e=>e.type==='text'&&e.bold)?.id||null,zoom=window.innerWidth<720?2:3.5,grid=false,snap=true,history=[],historyIndex=-1,savingTimer,toastTimer,lastFocus;
function resolveText(text){const f=state.fields;const map={'商品名稱':f.product,'標題':f.brand,'製造日期':formatDate(f.made,f),'有效日期':formatDate(expiryDate(f),f),'保存方式':f.storage,'批號':f.batch,'備註':f.note,'保存天數':f.days};return String(text).replace(/\{\{([^}]+)\}\}/g,(m,k)=>Object.hasOwn(map,k)?map[k]:m)}
function record(){let s=JSON.stringify(state);if(history[historyIndex]===s)return;history=history.slice(0,historyIndex+1);history.push(s);if(history.length>60)history.shift();historyIndex=history.length-1;updateHistory()}
function updateHistory(){$('undo').disabled=historyIndex<=0;$('redo').disabled=historyIndex>=history.length-1}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));storageOK=true;$('saveStatus').textContent='已儲存在此瀏覽器'}catch{$('saveStatus').textContent='無法自動儲存，請匯出備份';storageOK=false}}
function commit(){record();save()}
function toast(s){$('toast').textContent=s;$('toast').classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').classList.remove('show'),3200)}
function styleElement(node,e){Object.assign(node.style,{left:e.x+'mm',top:e.y+'mm',width:e.w+'mm',transform:'rotate('+e.rotation+'deg)'});if(e.type==='text'){node.textContent=resolveText(e.text);Object.assign(node.style,{fontSize:e.size+'pt',fontWeight:e.bold?'700':'400',textAlign:e.align,fontFamily:fonts[e.font]})}else node.style.borderTopWidth=e.thickness+'mm'}
function fillLabel(root,editor=false){root.innerHTML='';root.style.width=state.paper.w+'mm';root.style.height=state.paper.h+'mm';root.classList.toggle('grid',editor&&grid);state.elements.forEach(e=>{const node=document.createElement('div');node.className='label-element '+e.type+(editor&&selected===e.id?' selected':'');node.dataset.id=e.id;styleElement(node,e);if(editor){node.setAttribute('aria-label',e.type==='line'?'分隔線':resolveText(e.text));node.addEventListener('pointerdown',ev=>startDrag(ev,e.id));node.addEventListener('dblclick',()=>{$('propText')?.focus()})}root.append(node)});if(editor){let safe=document.createElement('div');safe.className='safe-guide';root.append(safe)}}
function renderCanvas(){const w=state.paper.w*MM*zoom,h=state.paper.h*MM*zoom;$('stageWrap').style.width=w+'px';$('stageWrap').style.height=h+'px';$('canvas').style.transform='scale('+zoom+')';fillLabel($('canvas'),true);$('rulerX').innerHTML='';$('rulerY').innerHTML='';for(let v=0;v<=state.paper.w;v++){let t=document.createElement('i');t.style.left=(v/state.paper.w*100)+'%';if(v%5===0){t.className='major';t.innerHTML='<b>'+v+'</b>'}$('rulerX').append(t)}for(let v=0;v<=state.paper.h;v++){let t=document.createElement('i');t.style.top=(v/state.paper.h*100)+'%';if(v%5===0){t.className='major';t.innerHTML='<b>'+v+'</b>'}$('rulerY').append(t)}$('zoomSelect').value=zoom;let dim=state.paper.w+' × '+state.paper.h+' mm';$('dimensionLabel').textContent=dim;$('sizeBadge').textContent=dim;$('printSummary').textContent=dim+' · 原尺寸列印';requestAnimationFrame(checkWarnings)}
function renderLayers(){$('layerCount').textContent=state.elements.length+' 個';$('layers').innerHTML='';state.elements.forEach(e=>{let row=document.createElement('div');row.className='layer-row'+(selected===e.id?' active':'');row.tabIndex=0;row.setAttribute('role','button');row.innerHTML='<span class="layer-symbol">'+(e.type==='line'?'―':'T')+'</span><span class="layer-name">'+escapeHTML(e.type==='line'?'分隔線':resolveText(e.text)||'空白文字')+'</span><small>'+(e.type==='line'?'線條':e.size+' pt')+'</small>';row.onclick=()=>select(e.id);row.onkeydown=ev=>{if(ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' '){ev.preventDefault();select(e.id)}};$('layers').append(row)});$('duplicateBtn').disabled=$('deleteBtn').disabled=!state.elements.some(e=>e.id===selected)}
function select(id){selected=id;renderCanvas();renderLayers();renderProperties()}
function selectedElement(){return state.elements.find(e=>e.id===selected)}
function renderProperties(){let e=selectedElement();if(!e){$('properties').innerHTML='<div class="empty-inspector">選取一個文字或線條<br>即可調整樣式與位置</div>';return}let num=(id,label,value,min,max,step='.1')=>'<label class="field"><span>'+label+'</span><input id="'+id+'" type="number" value="'+value+'" min="'+min+'" max="'+max+'" step="'+step+'"></label>';
let html='<h3>'+(e.type==='text'?'文字設定':'線條設定')+'</h3>';if(e.type==='text')html+='<label class="field"><span>文字內容</span><textarea id="propText" rows="2" maxlength="2000">'+escapeHTML(e.text)+'</textarea></label><div class="token-list">'+['商品名稱','標題','製造日期','有效日期','保存方式','批號','備註'].map(t=>'<button type="button" data-token="'+t+'">＋'+t+'</button>').join('')+'</div><p class="property-note">{{欄位}} 會隨左側商品資料自動更新。</p><div class="props-row"><label class="field" style="flex:1.7"><span>字體</span><select id="propFont" class="mini-select"><option value="sans">微軟正黑體</option><option value="serif">新細明體</option><option value="kai">標楷體</option><option value="mono">等寬字體</option></select></label>'+num('propSize','字級 pt',e.size,4,72,'.5')+'</div><div class="props-buttons" style="margin-bottom:15px"><button id="propBold" class="'+(e.bold?'active':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+e.bold+'"><b>B</b></button>'+['left','center','right'].map((a,i)=>'<button data-align="'+a+'" aria-label="'+['靠左對齊','置中對齊','靠右對齊'][i]+'" class="'+(e.align===a?'active':'')+'">'+icons(a)+'</button>').join('')+'</div>';
html+='<div class="props-row">'+num('propX','水平 X · mm',e.x,0,state.paper.w)+num('propY','垂直 Y · mm',e.y,0,state.paper.h)+'</div><div class="props-row">'+num('propWidth','寬度 mm',e.w,1,state.paper.w)+(e.type==='text'?'<label class="field"><span>旋轉</span><select id="propRotation" class="mini-select"><option value="0">0°</option><option value="90">90°</option><option value="180">180°</option><option value="270">270°</option></select></label>':num('propThickness','粗細 mm',e.thickness,.1,3,'.1'))+'</div><button id="centerObject" style="width:100%;font-size:11px">水平置於貼紙中央</button><p class="property-note" style="margin-bottom:0">方向鍵移動 0.1 mm，Shift＋方向鍵移動 1 mm。</p>';
$('properties').innerHTML=html;const bindNum=(id,key,min,max)=>{const input=$(id);if(!input)return;input.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(input.value==='')return;let value=Number(input.value);if(!Number.isFinite(value)||value<min||value>max)return;e[key]=round(value);renderCanvas();renderLayers();save()});input.addEventListener('change',()=>{let value=Number(input.value);if(!Number.isFinite(value))value=e[key];e[key]=round(clamp(value,min,max));input.value=e[key];renderCanvas();renderLayers();commit()})};bindNum('propX','x',0,state.paper.w);bindNum('propY','y',0,state.paper.h);bindNum('propWidth','w',1,state.paper.w);bindNum('propSize','size',4,72);bindNum('propThickness','thickness',.1,3);
if(e.type==='text'){$('propFont').value=e.font;$('propRotation').value=e.rotation;$('propText').oninput=()=>{e.text=$('propText').value;renderCanvas();renderLayers();save()};$('propText').onchange=commit;$('propFont').onchange=()=>{e.font=$('propFont').value;renderCanvas();commit()};$('propRotation').onchange=()=>{e.rotation=+$('propRotation').value;renderCanvas();commit()};$('propBold').onclick=()=>{e.bold=!e.bold;renderProperties();renderCanvas();commit()};document.querySelectorAll('[data-align]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{e.align=b.dataset.align;renderProperties();renderCanvas();commit()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-token]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const area=$('propText'),start=area.selectionStart,end=area.selectionEnd,token='{{'+b.dataset.token+'}}';e.text=area.value.slice(0,start)+token+area.value.slice(end);area.value=e.text;area.focus();area.setSelectionRange(start+token.length,start+token.length);renderCanvas();renderLayers();commit()})}$('centerObject').onclick=()=>{e.x=round((state.paper.w-e.w)/2);renderProperties();renderCanvas();commit()}}
function renderFields(){for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(state.fields)){if($(k))$(k).value=v}$('paperWidth').value=state.paper.w;$('paperHeight').value=state.paper.h;$('copies').value=state.copies;let preset=state.paper.w+','+state.paper.h;$('paperPreset').value=[...$('paperPreset').options].some(o=>o.value===preset)?preset:'custom';renderDates()}
function renderDates(){let f=state.fields;$('autoMode').classList.toggle('active',f.expiryMode==='auto');$('manualMode').classList.toggle('active',f.expiryMode==='manual');$('autoFields').hidden=f.expiryMode!=='auto';$('manualFields').hidden=f.expiryMode!=='manual';$('expiryValue').textContent=formatDate(expiryDate(f),f);$('dateFormula').textContent=f.expiryMode==='auto'?'製造日期 ＋ '+(f.days-(f.countMode==='inclusive'?1:0))+' 天。保存天數請依商品實際條件設定。':'依指定日期列印；請確認商品的實際保存期限。'}
function renderAll(){renderFields();renderCanvas();renderLayers();renderProperties();updateHistory();updatePageStyle()}
function updatePageStyle(){$('pageStyle').textContent='@page{size:'+state.paper.w+'mm '+state.paper.h+'mm;margin:0}';document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--paper-w',state.paper.w+'mm');document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--paper-h',state.paper.h+'mm')}
function warnings(){let msgs=[],f=state.fields;if(!f.product.trim())msgs.push('商品名稱尚未填寫');if(!validDate(f.made)||!validDate(expiryDate(f)))msgs.push('請填寫有效的日期');else if(expiryDate(f)<f.made)msgs.push('有效日期早於製造日期，請確認');else if(expiryDate(f)<localDate())msgs.push('有效日期已早於今天，請確認儲存的日期');if(!state.elements.length)msgs.push('貼紙尚未加入文字');let out=[],tiny=[];const labelRect=$('canvas').getBoundingClientRect();for(const e of state.elements){let el=[...$('canvas').children].find(el=>el.dataset.id===e.id);if(!el)continue;let r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=state.paper.offsetX*MM*zoom,dy=state.paper.offsetY*MM*zoom;if(r.left+dx<labelRect.left-.4||r.top+dy<labelRect.top-.4||r.right+dx>labelRect.right+.4||r.bottom+dy>labelRect.bottom+.4)out.push(e.type==='text'?resolveText(e.text).slice(0,15):'分隔線');if(e.type==='text'&&e.size<6&&e.text.trim())tiny.push(e.id)}if(out.length)msgs.push('部分物件超出貼紙範圍，可能被裁切：'+out.join('、'));if(tiny.length)msgs.push('部分文字小於 6 pt，請先試印確認清晰度');if(state.elements.some(e=>e.type==='text'&&/\{\{[^}]+\}\}/.test(resolveText(e.text))))msgs.push('文字含有不支援的欄位名稱');return msgs}
function checkWarnings(){const msgs=warnings();$('warnings').hidden=!msgs.length;$('warnings').textContent=msgs.join('；')}
function startDrag(ev,id){if(ev.button!==0)return;ev.preventDefault();record();selected=id;renderLayers();renderProperties();const el=ev.currentTarget;[...$('canvas').children].forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('selected',n.dataset.id===id));let e=selectedElement(),startX=ev.clientX,startY=ev.clientY,ox=e.x,oy=e.y,moved=false;el.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);const move=v=>{let dx=(v.clientX-startX)/MM/zoom,dy=(v.clientY-startY)/MM/zoom;if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>.05)moved=true;let x=ox+dx,y=oy+dy;if(snap){x=Math.round(x*2)/2;y=Math.round(y*2)/2}e.x=round(clamp(x,0,Math.max(0,state.paper.w-e.w)));e.y=round(clamp(y,0,Math.max(0,state.paper.h-el.offsetHeight/MM)));el.style.left=e.x+'mm';el.style.top=e.y+'mm';if($('propX'))$('propX').value=e.x;if($('propY'))$('propY').value=e.y};const end=()=>{el.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);el.removeEventListener('pointerup',end);el.removeEventListener('pointercancel',end);if(moved)commit();checkWarnings()};el.addEventListener('pointermove',move);el.addEventListener('pointerup',end);el.addEventListener('pointercancel',end)}
function setSize(w,h){state.paper.w=clamp(Number(w)||35,10,200);state.paper.h=clamp(Number(h)||25,10,300);renderAll();commit()}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-field]').forEach(el=>{el.addEventListener('input',()=>{let k=el.dataset.field;if(['made','manualExpiry'].includes(k)&&!validDate(el.value))return;if(k==='days'){if(!el.value)return;state.fields[k]=clamp(Math.round(Number(el.value)||1),1,3650)}else state.fields[k]=el.value;renderDates();renderCanvas();renderLayers();save()});el.addEventListener('change',()=>{if(el.dataset.field==='days')el.value=state.fields.days;if(['made','manualExpiry'].includes(el.dataset.field)&&!validDate(el.value)){el.value=state.fields[el.dataset.field];toast('請輸入完整日期')}commit()})});
$('autoMode').onclick=()=>{state.fields.expiryMode='auto';renderDates();renderCanvas();renderLayers();commit()};$('manualMode').onclick=()=>{if(state.fields.expiryMode==='auto')state.fields.manualExpiry=expiryDate(state.fields);state.fields.expiryMode='manual';renderAll();commit()};$('paperWidth').onchange=() =>setSize($('paperWidth').value,state.paper.h);$('paperHeight').onchange=()=>setSize(state.paper.w,$('paperHeight').value);$('paperPreset').onchange=()=>{if($('paperPreset').value!=='custom')setSize(...$('paperPreset').value.split(','))};$('swapSize').onclick=()=>setSize(state.paper.h,state.paper.w);
$('copies').oninput=()=>{if(!$('copies').value)return;state.copies=clamp(Math.round(Number($('copies').value)||1),1,200);save()};$('copies').onchange=()=>{state.copies=clamp(Math.round(Number($('copies').value)||1),1,200);$('copies').value=state.copies;commit()};$('gridToggle').onchange=()=>{grid=$('gridToggle').checked;renderCanvas()};$('snapToggle').onchange=()=>snap=$('snapToggle').checked;
function setZoom(z){zoom=clamp(z,1,6);renderCanvas()}$('zoomSelect').onchange=()=>setZoom(+$('zoomSelect').value);$('zoomOut').onclick=()=>setZoom(zoom-.5);$('zoomIn').onclick=()=>setZoom(zoom+.5);
function addElement(line=false){if(state.elements.length>=80)return toast('最多可加入 80 個物件');record();let e=line?{id:uid(),type:'line',x:2,y:Math.min(12,state.paper.h-2),w:state.paper.w-4,thickness:.2,rotation:0}:txt(uid(),'新增文字',2,Math.min(9,state.paper.h-5),state.paper.w-4,8);state.elements.push(e);selected=e.id;renderAll();commit();if(!line)$('propText').select()}
$('addText').onclick=()=>addElement();$('addLine').onclick=()=>addElement(true);$('duplicateBtn').onclick=()=>{let e=selectedElement();if(!e)return;if(state.elements.length>=80)return toast('最多可加入 80 個物件');record();let n=clone(e);n.id=uid();n.x=round(clamp(n.x+1,0,Math.max(0,state.paper.w-n.w)));n.y=round(clamp(n.y+1,0,state.paper.h-2));state.elements.push(n);selected=n.id;renderAll();commit()};
function deleteElement(){if(!selected)return;record();state.elements=state.elements.filter(e=>e.id!==selected);selected=null;renderAll();commit()}$('deleteBtn').onclick=deleteElement;
function undo(){record();if(historyIndex>0){state=JSON.parse(history[--historyIndex]);renderAll();save()}}function redo(){if(historyIndex<history.length-1){state=JSON.parse(history[++historyIndex]);renderAll();save()}}$('undo').onclick=undo;$('redo').onclick=redo;
document.addEventListener('keydown',ev=>{if(!$('modal').hidden){if(ev.key==='Escape')closeModal();if(ev.key==='Tab'){let list=[...$('modal').querySelectorAll('button,input,select,textarea,a[href]')].filter(x=>!x.disabled&&x.offsetParent!==null),first=list[0],last=list.at(-1);if(ev.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){ev.preventDefault();last?.focus()}else if(!ev.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){ev.preventDefault();first?.focus()}}return}let input=/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(document.activeElement.tagName);if((ev.ctrlKey||ev.metaKey)&&ev.key.toLowerCase()==='p'){ev.preventDefault();openPrint();return}if(input)return;if((ev.ctrlKey||ev.metaKey)&&ev.key.toLowerCase()==='z'){ev.preventDefault();ev.shiftKey?redo():undo();return}if((ev.ctrlKey||ev.metaKey)&&ev.key.toLowerCase()==='y'){ev.preventDefault();redo();return}if(ev.key==='Delete'||ev.key==='Backspace'){ev.preventDefault();deleteElement()}if(ev.key.startsWith('Arrow')&&selectedElement()){ev.preventDefault();let e=selectedElement(),delta=ev.shiftKey?1:.1;record();if(ev.key==='ArrowLeft')e.x=round(Math.max(0,e.x-delta));if(ev.key==='ArrowRight')e.x=round(Math.min(state.paper.w-e.w,e.x+delta));if(ev.key==='ArrowUp')e.y=round(Math.max(0,e.y-delta));if(ev.key==='ArrowDown')e.y=round(Math.min(state.paper.h-1,e.y+delta));renderAll();commit()}});
let modalScroll=null,previewResizeObserver=null;
function updateModalViewport(){const viewport=window.visualViewport;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--modal-viewport-height',(viewport?.height||window.innerHeight)+'px');document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--modal-viewport-top',(viewport?.offsetTop||0)+'px')}
function lockModalScroll(){if(modalScroll)return;modalScroll={x:window.scrollX,y:window.scrollY};document.documentElement.classList.add('modal-open');document.body.classList.add('modal-open');document.body.style.top=-modalScroll.y+'px'}
function unlockModalScroll(){if(!modalScroll)return;const saved=modalScroll;modalScroll=null;document.documentElement.classList.remove('modal-open');document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');document.body.style.top='';window.scrollTo(saved.x,saved.y)}
function openModal(title,body,actions=[]){const opening=$('modal').hidden;if(opening){lastFocus=document.activeElement;lastFocus?.blur();lockModalScroll()}previewResizeObserver?.disconnect();previewResizeObserver=null;updateModalViewport();$('modalTitle').textContent=title;$('modalBody').innerHTML=body;$('modalActions').innerHTML='';actions.forEach(a=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=a.label;b.className=a.primary?'primary':'';b.onclick=a.action;$('modalActions').append(b)});$('modal').hidden=false;$('modalBody').scrollTop=0;$('closeModal').focus({preventScroll:true})}
function closeModal(){previewResizeObserver?.disconnect();previewResizeObserver=null;$('modal').hidden=true;unlockModalScroll();if(lastFocus?.isConnected)lastFocus.focus({preventScroll:true})}$('closeModal').onclick=closeModal;$('modal').onclick=ev=>{if(ev.target===$('modal'))closeModal()};
window.addEventListener('resize',updateModalViewport);window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize',updateModalViewport);window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('scroll',updateModalViewport);
function makePreview(container){const holder=document.createElement('div');holder.className='preview-holder';holder.style.overflow='hidden';holder.style.background='#fff';const label=document.createElement('div');label.className='label-root preview-label';fillLabel(label);holder.append(label);container.append(holder);const fit=()=>{if(!container.isConnected)return;const style=getComputedStyle(container),available=Math.max(1,container.clientWidth-parseFloat(style.paddingLeft)-parseFloat(style.paddingRight));const factor=Math.min(3,available/(state.paper.w*MM),300/(state.paper.h*MM));holder.style.width=state.paper.w*MM*factor+'px';holder.style.height=state.paper.h*MM*factor+'px';label.style.left=state.paper.offsetX*MM*factor+'px';label.style.top=state.paper.offsetY*MM*factor+'px';label.style.transform='scale('+factor+')'};fit();if(window.ResizeObserver){previewResizeObserver=new ResizeObserver(fit);previewResizeObserver.observe(container)}}

function preparePrint(count=state.copies){updatePageStyle();$('printOutput').innerHTML='';for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let sheet=document.createElement('div');sheet.className='print-sheet';let label=document.createElement('div');label.className='label-root';fillLabel(label);label.style.left=state.paper.offsetX+'mm';label.style.top=state.paper.offsetY+'mm';sheet.append(label);$('printOutput').append(sheet)}}
let activePrintAttempt=null,printFeedbackTimer=null,pdfJob=0;
function printFallback(count,message){document.title='標籤工房 · 商品貼紙編輯器';openModal('沒有看到列印視窗？','<p>'+escapeHTML(message)+'</p><div class="help-grid" style="margin-top:16px"><div><strong>手機 / App 內開啟</strong><p>請輸出原尺寸 PDF，再使用「開啟 PDF」或「分享 PDF」交給系統列印。若分享選單沒有列印，可先儲存至檔案，再開啟 PDF 操作。</p></div><div><strong>Windows 電腦</strong><p>使用 Chrome 或 Edge 開啟本頁，或下載 PDF 後列印。貼紙機的紙張尺寸仍須設為 '+state.paper.w+' × '+state.paper.h+' mm。</p></div></div><p style="margin-top:12px">網頁無法確認紙張是否已印出。PDF 會包含 '+count+' 頁，每頁一張貼紙。</p>',[{label:'返回編輯',action:closeModal},{label:'輸出 PDF',primary:true,action:()=>exportLabelPdf(count)}])}
function printNow(test=false){const count=test?1:state.copies;const attempt={count,before:false,after:false};activePrintAttempt=attempt;clearTimeout(printFeedbackTimer);pendingPrintCount=count;preparePrint(count);closeModal();document.title=state.fields.product+'_'+formatDate(expiryDate(state.fields),state.fields)+'_標籤';try{window.print()}catch{pendingPrintCount=null;printFallback(count,'目前瀏覽器無法開啟直接列印。可以改用 PDF 列印。');return}printFeedbackTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(activePrintAttempt!==attempt||attempt.after||!$('modal').hidden)return;pendingPrintCount=null;printFallback(count,attempt.before?'已送出列印要求。如果沒有出現系統列印視窗，請改用下方的 PDF 列印。':'目前瀏覽器沒有回報開啟列印視窗。App 內建瀏覽器可能不支援直接列印，請改用下方的 PDF 列印。')},1200)}
window.addEventListener('beforeprint',()=>{if(activePrintAttempt)activePrintAttempt.before=true;preparePrint(pendingPrintCount??state.copies)});window.addEventListener('afterprint',()=>{if(activePrintAttempt)activePrintAttempt.after=true;clearTimeout(printFeedbackTimer);pendingPrintCount=null;document.title='標籤工房 · 商品貼紙編輯器';$('printOutput').innerHTML=''});
function openPrint(previewOnly=false){const msgs=warnings();openModal(previewOnly?'貼紙預覽':'確認標籤與列印設定',(msgs.length?'<div class="warning modal-warning">'+escapeHTML(msgs.join('；'))+'</div>':'')+'<div class="preview-well" id="previewWell"></div><div class="row space"><strong style="font-size:13px">'+state.paper.w+' × '+state.paper.h+' mm</strong><span class="chip">'+state.copies+' 張 · 每頁一張貼紙</span></div><p style="margin-top:10px">畫面為放大預覽；列印與 PDF 都依設定的毫米尺寸輸出。</p><div class="print-route-note"><strong>手機或 App 內列印沒有反應？</strong><p>按下方「輸出 PDF」，開啟檔案後再列印。Windows Chrome / Edge 可使用直接列印。</p></div><ol class="steps"><li><span>選擇已安裝的貼紙機，紙張設為 <b>'+state.paper.w+' × '+state.paper.h+' mm</b>。若沒有此尺寸，先到 Windows 印表機喜好設定新增。</span></li><li><span>縮放設為 <b>100% / 實際大小</b>、邊界「無」，關閉頁首及頁尾。「份數」維持 <b>1</b>，本程式已產生 '+state.copies+' 頁。</span></li><li><span>首次請先試印一張；有偏移時可使用「位置校正」。手機列印還需要印表機或其 App 支援。</span></li></ol>',[{label:'試印 1 張',action:()=>printNow(true)},{label:'輸出 PDF',action:()=>exportLabelPdf(state.copies)},{label:'列印 '+state.copies+' 張',primary:true,action:()=>printNow()}]);makePreview($('previewWell'))}
// Rasterize using the browser's actual line breaks, fonts and millimetre layout.
// A high-resolution image keeps Chinese glyphs portable without external fonts.
function renderLabelRaster(){const w=state.paper.w*MM,h=state.paper.h*MM,scale=Math.min(600/96,4096/Math.max(w,h));const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=Math.ceil(w*scale);canvas.height=Math.ceil(h*scale);const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)throw Error('目前瀏覽器無法建立貼紙影像');ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.scale(canvas.width/w,canvas.height/h);ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';ctx.textAlign='left';const measure=document.createElement('div');measure.className='label-root';Object.assign(measure.style,{position:'fixed',left:'0',top:'0',opacity:'0',pointerEvents:'none',zIndex:'-1',overflow:'visible',transform:'none'});fillLabel(measure);document.body.append(measure);const range=document.createRange();const segmenter=typeof Intl.Segmenter==='function'?new Intl.Segmenter('zh-Hant',{granularity:'grapheme'}):null;
try{for(let i=0;i<state.elements.length;i++){const e=state.elements[i],node=measure.children[i];node.style.transform='none';const box=node.getBoundingClientRect(),style=getComputedStyle(node),x=(e.x+state.paper.offsetX)*MM,y=(e.y+state.paper.offsetY)*MM;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x+box.width/2,y+box.height/2);ctx.rotate((e.rotation||0)*Math.PI/180);ctx.translate(-box.width/2,-box.height/2);if(e.type==='line'){ctx.fillRect(0,0,e.w*MM,e.thickness*MM);ctx.restore();continue}const text=node.textContent,textNode=node.firstChild;if(!text||!textNode){ctx.restore();continue}ctx.font=style.fontWeight+' '+style.fontSize+' '+style.fontFamily;const probe=document.createElement('span');Object.assign(probe.style,{position:'absolute',left:'0',top:'0',fontFamily:style.fontFamily,fontSize:style.fontSize,fontWeight:style.fontWeight,lineHeight:style.lineHeight,whiteSpace:'pre'});const sample=document.createTextNode(text.replace(/\s/g,'').slice(0,1)||'M');const marker=document.createElement('span');Object.assign(marker.style,{display:'inline-block',width:'0',height:'0',verticalAlign:'baseline'});probe.append(sample,marker);measure.append(probe);range.selectNodeContents(sample);const baselineDelta=marker.getBoundingClientRect().top-range.getBoundingClientRect().top;probe.remove();const lines=[];let index=0;const segments=segmenter?[...segmenter.segment(text)].map(v=>v.segment):Array.from(text);for(const char of segments){const start=index;index+=char.length;if(char==='\n'||char==='\r')continue;range.setStart(textNode,start);range.setEnd(textNode,index);const r=range.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width||!r.height)continue;let line=lines.at(-1);if(!line||Math.abs(line.top-r.top)>.5){line={text:'',left:r.left,top:r.top};lines.push(line)}line.text+=char}for(const line of lines)ctx.fillText(line.text,line.left-box.left,line.top-box.top+baselineDelta);ctx.restore()}}finally{measure.remove()}return canvas}
function buildLabelPdf(jpeg,widthPx,heightPx,widthMm,heightMm,count){const enc=new TextEncoder(),parts=[],offsets=[0];let length=0;const push=value=>{const bytes=typeof value==='string'?enc.encode(value):value;parts.push(bytes);length+=bytes.length};const obj=(id,data)=>{offsets[id]=length;push(id+' 0 obj\n');push(data);push('\nendobj\n')};const points=v=>(v*72/25.4).toFixed(6),pw=points(widthMm),ph=points(heightMm);push('%PDF-1.4\n%LabelWorkshop\n');obj(1,'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /ViewerPreferences << /PrintScaling /None /NumCopies 1 >> >>');obj(2,'<< /Type /Pages /Count '+count+' /Kids ['+Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>(i+5)+' 0 R').join(' ')+'] >>');offsets[3]=length;push('3 0 obj\n<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width '+widthPx+' /Height '+heightPx+' /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length '+jpeg.length+' >>\nstream\n');push(jpeg);push('\nendstream\nendobj\n');const content='q\n'+pw+' 0 0 '+ph+' 0 0 cm\n/Label Do\nQ\n';obj(4,'<< /Length '+enc.encode(content).length+' >>\nstream\n'+content+'endstream');for(let i=0;i<count;i++)obj(i+5,'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 '+pw+' '+ph+'] /Resources << /XObject << /Label 3 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>');const xref=length;push('xref\n0 '+offsets.length+'\n0000000000 65535 f \n');for(let i=1;i<offsets.length;i++)push(String(offsets[i]).padStart(10,'0')+' 00000 n \n');push('trailer\n<< /Size '+offsets.length+' /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n'+xref+'\n%%EOF');return new Blob(parts,{type:'application/pdf'})}
async function exportLabelPdf(count=state.copies){clearTimeout(printFeedbackTimer);activePrintAttempt=null;pendingPrintCount=null;const job=++pdfJob;count=clamp(Math.round(count)||1,1,200);openModal('正在製作列印 PDF','<p>正在產生 '+count+' 頁原尺寸貼紙，請稍候…</p>',[{label:'取消',action:()=>{pdfJob++;closeModal()}}]);try{if(document.fonts?.ready)await document.fonts.ready;if(job!==pdfJob||$('modal').hidden)return;const canvas=renderLabelRaster();const raster=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',1),raw=atob(raster.split(',')[1]),jpeg=Uint8Array.from(raw,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const blob=buildLabelPdf(jpeg,canvas.width,canvas.height,state.paper.w,state.paper.h,count),filename='Label-'+state.paper.w+'x'+state.paper.h+'mm-'+count+'pages.pdf',url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),20*60*1000);const pdfFile=new File([blob],filename,{type:'application/pdf'});let canShare=false;try{canShare=!!(navigator.share&&navigator.canShare?.({files:[pdfFile]}))}catch{}openModal('列印 PDF 已準備好','<div class="preview-well"><img class="pdf-preview" src="'+raster+'" alt="PDF 貼紙內容預覽"></div><div class="row space"><strong style="font-size:13px">'+state.paper.w+' × '+state.paper.h+' mm</strong><span class="chip">'+count+' 頁 · 每頁一張</span></div><p style="margin-top:12px">PDF 已包含目前的文字排版與位置校正。請以 <b>100% / 實際大小</b>列印，份數設為 1。</p><div class="print-route-note"><strong>手機怎麼列印？</strong><p>開啟 PDF 後，使用檢視器的分享或列印選單；或先下載到「檔案」再開啟。若貼紙機只安裝在 Windows，請把 PDF 傳到該電腦列印。</p></div><p id="pdfShareStatus" class="input-help" role="status"></p>',[{label:'返回預覽',action:()=>openPrint(true)},...(canShare?[{label:'分享 PDF',action:()=>{navigator.share({files:[pdfFile],title:'商品標籤 PDF'}).catch(error=>{$('pdfShareStatus').textContent=error.name==='AbortError'?'已取消分享。仍可使用開啟或下載 PDF。':'此瀏覽器無法分享檔案，請改用開啟或下載 PDF。'})}}]:[])]);const link=(id,label,download)=>{const a=document.createElement('a');a.id=id;a.textContent=label;a.href=url;a.className='pdf-link'+(!download?' primary':'');if(download)a.download=filename;else{a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener'}$('modalActions').append(a)};link('openPdf','開啟 PDF',false);link('downloadPdf','下載 PDF',true)}catch(error){if(job!==pdfJob)return;openModal('PDF 製作失敗','<p>暫時無法建立 PDF：'+escapeHTML(error.message||'未知錯誤')+'。請重新嘗試，或使用 Windows Chrome / Edge 直接列印。</p>',[{label:'返回預覽',primary:true,action:()=>openPrint(true)}])}}

$('printBtn').onclick=()=>openPrint();$('previewBtn').onclick=()=>openPrint(true);
function openCalibration(){openModal('列印設定與位置校正','<p>先試印一張，依實際出紙位置調整。正值向右 / 向下移動，負值向左 / 向上移動；不會改變貼紙尺寸。</p><div class="props-row" style="margin-top:20px"><label class="field"><span>水平偏移（mm）</span><input id="offsetX" type="number" min="-10" max="10" step=".1" value="'+state.paper.offsetX+'"></label><label class="field"><span>垂直偏移（mm）</span><input id="offsetY" type="number" min="-10" max="10" step=".1" value="'+state.paper.offsetY+'"></label></div><p class="input-help">例如印出來偏右 1 mm，水平偏移可設為 −1。校正會顯示於列印預覽，編輯畫布維持原始位置。</p><div class="help-grid" style="margin-top:20px"><div><strong>Windows 貼紙機</strong><p>在印表機喜好設定建立相同的紙張寬、高，依設備設定間隙紙 / 黑標紙等紙張類型。</p></div><div><strong>瀏覽器列印</strong><p>選擇正確印表機、相同尺寸、100% 縮放、無邊界，並關閉頁首及頁尾。</p></div></div><p style="margin-top:15px">網頁透過列印視窗使用 Windows 印表機，無法直接讀取貼紙機型號或自動修改驅動設定。</p>',[{label:'取消',action:closeModal},{label:'儲存校正',primary:true,action:()=>{state.paper.offsetX=round(clamp(Number($('offsetX').value)||0,-10,10));state.paper.offsetY=round(clamp(Number($('offsetY').value)||0,-10,10));commit();checkWarnings();closeModal();toast('已儲存列印位置校正')}}])}$('calibrateBtn').onclick=openCalibration;
function getTemplates(){try{let t=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LIBKEY)||'[]');return Array.isArray(t)?t:[]}catch{return []}}
function saveTemplates(t){try{localStorage.setItem(LIBKEY,JSON.stringify(t));return true}catch{toast('儲存空間不足，請匯出 JSON 備份');return false}}
$('saveTemplateBtn').onclick=()=>{openModal('儲存常用版型','<p>儲存目前的排版、尺寸與商品資料。下次開啟後，請再確認製造日期和有效日期。</p><label class="field" style="margin-top:18px"><span>版型名稱</span><input id="templateName" maxlength="60" value="'+escapeHTML(state.fields.product||'我的標籤')+'"></label>',[{label:'取消',action:closeModal},{label:'儲存版型',primary:true,action:()=>{let name=$('templateName').value.trim();if(!name)return toast('請填入版型名稱');let all=getTemplates();if(all.length>=50)return toast('最多儲存 50 個版型，請先刪除不需要的版型');all.push({id:uid(),name,state:clone(state)});if(saveTemplates(all)){closeModal();toast('已儲存「'+name+'」')}}}]);$('templateName').select()};
function loadTemplate(s,message){record();try{state=normalize(s)}catch(e){return toast(e.message)}selected=state.elements[0]?.id||null;renderAll();commit();closeModal();toast(message)}
function openTemplates(){let all=getTemplates();openModal('我的版型','<p>從基本版型開始，或載入自己的常用商品。</p><div class="template-grid"><button class="template-card" data-builtin="0"><div class="template-thumb" style="text-align:center"><span>日日手作</span><strong>商品名稱</strong><span>─────────</span><span>製造日期　2026/11/11<br>有效日期　2026/11/13</span></div><strong>簡約保存期限</strong><small>35 × 25 mm</small></button><button class="template-card" data-builtin="1"><div class="template-thumb"><strong>商品名稱</strong><span>─────────</span><span>製造：2026/11/11<br>有效：2026/11/13<br>批號：A001</span></div><strong>完整商品資訊</strong><small>35 × 25 mm</small></button><button class="template-card" data-builtin="2"><div class="template-thumb" style="text-align:center"><span>商品名稱</span><span>有效日期</span><strong>2026/11/13</strong><span>保存方式</span></div><strong>大字有效日期</strong><small>35 × 25 mm</small></button></div><div class="row space"><strong style="font-size:12px">已儲存的版型</strong><small>'+all.length+' / 50</small></div><div id="savedTemplates">'+(all.length?'':'<p style="padding:18px 0;color:#9ba593">尚無儲存版型。編輯完成後按「儲存版型」。</p>')+'</div><div class="split"><button id="exportJSON">'+icons('download')+'匯出目前版型</button><button id="importJSON">匯入版型 JSON</button></div><p class="input-help">套用版型會替換目前排版，可按「復原」還原；基本版型保留左側商品資料。</p>',[{label:'完成',primary:true,action:closeModal}]);document.querySelectorAll('[data-builtin]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{record();state.elements=builtins(+b.dataset.builtin);state.paper.w=35;state.paper.h=25;selected=state.elements.find(e=>e.id==='product')?.id;renderAll();commit();closeModal();toast('已套用基本版型，商品資料已保留')});all.forEach(t=>{let row=document.createElement('div');row.className='saved-template';let title=document.createElement('span');title.textContent=t.name;let load=document.createElement('button');load.textContent='套用';load.onclick=()=>loadTemplate(t.state,'已載入版型，請確認商品日期');let del=document.createElement('button');del.innerHTML=icons('trash');del.setAttribute('aria-label','刪除版型 '+t.name);del.onclick=()=>{openModal('刪除儲存版型','<p>確定刪除「'+escapeHTML(t.name)+'」？目前正在編輯的貼紙不會受影響。</p>',[{label:'取消',action:openTemplates},{label:'刪除版型',primary:true,action:()=>{if(saveTemplates(getTemplates().filter(x=>x.id!==t.id))){openTemplates();toast('已刪除版型')}}}])};row.append(title,load,del);$('savedTemplates').append(row)});$('exportJSON').onclick=exportJSON;$('importJSON').onclick=()=>$('importFile').click()}
$('templatesBtn').onclick=openTemplates;
function download(data,name,type){let url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type})),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),2000)}
function exportJSON(){download(JSON.stringify(state,null,2),'label-template-'+localDate()+'.json','application/json');toast('已匯出版型，可保存到 Windows 電腦')}
$('importFile').onchange=async()=>{let file=$('importFile').files[0];if(!file)return;if(file.size>1024*1024){$('importFile').value='';return toast('版型檔案太大，請選擇 1 MB 以內的 JSON')}try{let next=normalize(JSON.parse(await file.text()));loadTemplate(next,'已匯入版型，請確認日期')}catch(e){toast('匯入失敗：'+e.message)}$('importFile').value=''};

$('helpBtn').onclick=()=>{openModal('開始使用標籤工房','<div class="help-grid"><div><strong>01　填寫商品資料</strong><p>輸入品名、標題與保存方式。可依保存天數計算有效日期，也能自行指定。</p></div><div><strong>02　自由排版</strong><p>在畫布拖曳文字；選取後可調整字體、字級、對齊、寬度、旋轉和毫米位置。</p></div><div><strong>03　儲存常用商品</strong><p>版型保存在目前瀏覽器。換電腦前請匯出 JSON，於另一台電腦匯入。</p></div><div><strong>04　試印與列印</strong><p>Windows Chrome / Edge 可直接列印；手機或 App 內可輸出 PDF，再開啟檔案列印。先以 100% 原尺寸試印一張。</p></div></div><p style="margin-top:17px">畫布上的綠色虛線是 1 mm 參考安全邊界，不會列印。縮放僅改變編輯畫面，列印尺寸由貼紙寬高決定。指定字體須已安裝在使用電腦上，否則會套用替代字體。</p><p style="margin-top:10px">日期、保存方式與天數均為可修改欄位；示範資料不代表實際商品的保存條件。儲存版型後的日期不會自動切換到今天。</p><p style="margin-top:10px">離線使用：下載 HTML 後，使用 Windows 的 Chrome / Edge 開啟即可，不需安裝其他軟體。資料不會跨瀏覽器同步。</p><div class="split"><button id="offlineBtn">'+icons('download')+'下載 Windows 離線版</button><button id="helpExport">匯出目前版型</button></div>',[{label:'開始編輯',primary:true,action:closeModal}]);$('offlineBtn').onclick=downloadOffline;$('helpExport').onclick=exportJSON};
